verdict.rationale: Poke is a cloud AI assistant service that stores user memory, integrations and messages, so data-residency choice is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options or choosing where data is stored. The docs cover only messaging channels, integrations, MCP, recipes and billing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
